text: Which consultancies in Sydney are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

sections.text:
For Sydney organisations, the strongest shortlist is:

- **Essential Tech** — Best for end-to-end Power Automate implementation, Dynamics 365/Microsoft 365 integration, RPA and ongoing support. It operates in Sydney and offers assessment, implementation, integration and service-desk support.[6]
- **OfficePro Consulting** — Best for Microsoft 365-centric businesses wanting practical workflow automation, clear scoping and handover. Its Sydney offering covers Power Automate approvals, reminders, notifications, Power Apps and Power BI.[7]
- **LOOKUP** — Best for process discovery and controlled automation involving Power Automate Cloud/Desktop, SharePoint, Teams, AI Builder and APIs. Its stated approach includes testing, exception handling, training and performance monitoring.[9]
- **C9** — Best for larger bespoke software, integration and database projects where Power Automate is part of a broader custom solution. C9 reports typical projects of four to twelve weeks, but delivery is from its Brisbane headquarters rather than a Sydney office.[2][5]
- **A1 Technologies** — Best for structured workflow assessment and implementation of more complex, scalable Power Automate solutions integrated with existing systems.[8]
- **Power Platform Experts** — Best for organisations wanting a specialist across the broader Microsoft stack: Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI and Power Pages, with implementation, training and support.[10]
- **Azar Consulting** — Worth considering for custom integrations and newer AI-enabled operational workflows; it is based in Chiswick, Sydney, and lists Power Automate alongside APIs, n8n, Zapier and custom development.[3]

### Recommended choice by requirement

| Requirement | Best-fit consultancies |
|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 approvals, forms and notifications | OfficePro, Essential Tech |
| Power Automate Desktop and legacy applications | Essential Tech, LOOKUP, C9 |
| SharePoint, Teams and Power Platform integration | LOOKUP, Power Platform Experts, OfficePro |
| Complex integrations and custom software | C9, A1 Technologies, Azar Consulting |
| AI-assisted document and workflow automation | LOOKUP, Azar Consulting |
| Ongoing managed support | Essential Tech, LOOKUP |
| Broader Power Platform capability | Power Platform Experts, OfficePro |

Before selecting a provider, ask for two or three comparable case studies, confirmation of Microsoft certifications or partner status, ownership of the Power Platform environment, documentation and handover arrangements, support SLAs, licensing assumptions, and a plan for error handling and governance.

For a typical Sydney SME, the practical first shortlist would be **OfficePro Consulting, Essential Tech and LOOKUP**. For a larger transformation involving custom applications or complex integrations, add **C9** and **A1 Technologies**.
